title: Suggested alignment revision
text: This course introduces students to the vital role of computers and computer programmers in shaping modern society. It builds a strong foundation in logical problem formulation and good coding practices. Students learn the fundamentals of Java programming: console input/output, variables, data types and operators, conditional statements, loops, arrays, strings, methods and recursion, and connecting Java programs to a database using UCanAccess. In line with La Consolacion University Philippines' commitment to forming Christo-centric Catholic professionals, the course integrates Marian Augustinian values in each lesson, so that students grow intellectually and cultivate moral and ethical responsibility in the digital age. This holistic approach nurtures individuals who contribute positively to society, embodying community, humility, and love of service, as exemplified by the Blessed Virgin Mary and Saint Augustine. By the end of the course, students will have created their own Java applications, demonstrating both technical proficiency and a sense of purpose rooted in their Catholic faith.
